implementation: Q4T probabilities use SIMD binary64 range reduction/polynomial evaluation with a conservative binary32 midpoint guard. Binary32 subtraction/probability rounding and the chronological binary64 denominator sum are preserved. Uncertain lanes and other domains use Numerics.Exp. The existing SiTU scale table is shared without changing its arithmetic.

Native five/six-query IQ3_S kernels decode each block once, preserve integer lanes/FP32 FMA chains and ordered binary64 folds, and write mapped outputs directly. Existing one-to-four and seven/eight-query support remains.

Explicit decode pipelining and bounded next-row prefetch were implemented and numerically qualified, then excluded because their hot/cold component comparisons did not establish consistent benefits. No loading experiment remains active.

component.loading_decision: Both loading variants qualified numerically but not selected: explicit pipeline generally lost throughput; row prefetch lacked consistent gains relative to its reference controls. No new prefetch or decode pipeline retained.
